name: account-rotator
description: Moves Claude Code between your Claude accounts as their usage limits fill, shows each account's usage under the prompt, and signs an account back in with one click. One coordinator process serves every session.

chrome.title: Claude in Chrome support
chrome.description: Connect Claude in Chrome as the account your Chrome extension is signed in to: sessions visit that account as they open and when the connection drops, and the panel has a Chrome box. Turn it off if you don't use Claude in Chrome.
